Container.Name: gramps-web-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP server for Gramps Web — structured AI agent access to your family tree over HTTP.
Container.Description:
Companion service for [Gramps Web](https://www.grampsweb.org/). Exposes the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) over Streamable HTTP so MCP clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Open WebUI, and others) can search, read, and optionally modify your genealogy data.
**Prerequisites** - A running Gramps Web instance with API access - Tree UUID and either an API username/password or a refresh token
**Usage** - After install, point MCP clients at `http://[host]:[PORT:8080]/mcp`
Container.Requires: Internet access to pull the container image and reach your Gramps Web API URL.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-10-02 (2.1.1) - Pin container image to 2.1.1 - Show Gramps IDs in search results; name linked objects on person and family cards, the root person in trees, and other event participants in timelines. Clarify reference edits in recent changes. - Hide unavailable thumbnail resources for non-image media, omit empty media and citation dates, and display names and dates consistently with Gramps Web. - Keep relatives' events in person timelines when the person's first event has an imprecise date.

### 2026-10-01 (2.0.1) - Pin container image to 2.0.1 - Add configurable GRAMPS_LOG_LEVEL; Information logs API method, path, status, duration, and body length without genealogy data. Debug and Trace include full URLs and request/response bodies. - Ignore unresolved placeholders in blank optional MCPB fields and fall back to password login when a refresh token is rejected with HTTP 422. - Fix get_recent_changes pagination so pagesize limits the returned history.
### 2026-10-01 (2.0.0) - Pin container image to 2.0.0 - Breaking change: consolidate read, delete, timeline, person-tree, reference, and media tools; MCP catalog now has 31 tools instead of 57. Config.Name: Gramps API URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Gramps Web instance (no trailing slash).

Config.Name: Gramps Username
Config.Description: Gramps Web API username; use with Gramps Password, or leave blank when using a refresh token.

Config.Name: Gramps Password
Config.Description: Gramps Web API password; use with Gramps Username, or leave blank when using a refresh token.

Config.Name: Gramps Refresh Token
Config.Description: Alternative to username and password, including when local password authentication is disabled.

Config.Name: Gramps Tree ID
Config.Description: Tree UUID on the Gramps Web server.

Config.Name: Read Only Mode
Config.Description: Set to true to publish only read tools and block direct create, update, and delete calls.

Config.Name: MCP API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for HTTP/SSE access (Bearer or X-Api-Key). Recommended when the MCP port is reachable from other machines.

Config.Name: Mutation Serialize
Config.Description: Serialize create, update, and delete HTTP calls in-process to reduce SQLite lock errors.

Config.Name: Mutation Min Interval MS
Config.Description: Optional minimum milliseconds between mutation HTTP calls (0 disables pacing).

Config.Name: Enable Media Resources
Config.Description: Enable read_media and binary media resources for thumbnails and full files.

Config.Name: Media Max Bytes
Config.Description: Maximum bytes returned by a media file or rendered preview; thumbnail generation can read originals up to 50 MiB or this limit if higher.

Config.Name: Allow Private Media
Config.Description: Allow media bytes for Gramps records marked private.

Config.Name: Gramps Log Level
Config.Description: Server log level: Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, or None. Debug and Trace log genealogy data from API bodies.

Config.Name: MCP HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to container port 8080 (MCP endpoint at /mcp).
